description: This bar chart illustrates Shapley values for four different models—mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM—across seven linguistic probes labeled L₄⁻, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The horizontal axis represents the linguistic probes, listed in the order L₄⁻, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and is labeled as such. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each probe, there is a grouped set of three bars representing the Shapley value for each model. The mBERT model is represented by a light orange bar, XLM-R by a dark blue bar, and chLSTM by a light green bar. For the L₄⁻ probe, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 3, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 1, and the chLSTM bar is less than 1. At the T probe, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 60, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 58, and the chLSTM bar reaches approximately 12. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each probe, and no bars are visually emphasized.
